jobs.title: Software Engineer - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high-quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from healthcare to social care. We work closely with our Finnish customers to develop our own products and services. We want to provide solutions which enable healthcare and social care professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients and customers. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join a Patient Engagement development team. Our activities are directed at supporting the citizen-oriented parts of the healthcare system manufactured by Tieto and they include analysis, design, development, testing, maintenance, and release tasks. You will have opportunities to design and develop new features, maintain existing applications, and configure them in our SaaS environments. The work is going to be performed in a hybrid mode, giving the opportunity to work either from the office or from home, according to the agreed schedule.

Who we are looking for:

You live in (or at a commuting distance to) Szczecin, Warsaw or Wroclaw.
You have a good working proficiency in English, both spoken and written.
You have at least 3 years of experience of working professionally as a Software Engineer on commercial projects.
You have a full stack developer attitude with the primary focus on backend development
You have good practical knowledge of .Net framework, .Net 8+, and SQL, especially the Microsoft SQL flavor, including the Service broker functionality. You can use the Entity Framework in C# to access and use the databases.
You are a person with confidence to take responsibility and ownership.
You have the right personality and attitude to work together in a team, learn from your peers and pass on what you’ve learned to others.
You consider the testing as a natural component of the development flow, both in terms of creating unit/integration tests as well as executing the manual tests in the test environments.
You are familiar with web services (REST, SOAP) and know how to develop, deploy, and test them using IIS as a host

Nice to have skills:

You have experience in developing software for the SaaS environments.
You have basic experience with Angular, CSS, HTML, Javascript.
You are familiar with Git and Azure DevOps

We offer

We offer you an inspiring position with great opportunities for professional growth. With us you will have the opportunity to directly influence your career development. If you have good ideas, people will listen to you. What's more, we offer you a job that suits you. At Tieto, we promote a healthy work-life balance and a friendly, caring atmosphere. We believe that trust fosters freedom and creativity. Our culture is built on transparency and active sharing – a truly open environment.

In addition to this we offer you great benefits and opportunity to work with inspiring colleagues. With us you will be working with highly skilled professionals and experience being a part of the Tieto software development network.

Did we get you inspired?

We look forward to your application! Interviews will be held on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact Tomasz Lisowski ( tomasz.lisowski@tieto.com)

What’s in it for you?

With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.

Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto

Stay alert to recruitment scams:

Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure Databricks and Azure DevOps to design and implement scalable cloud-based data solutions. The applications primarily consist of data pipelines built in Azure Databricks. They either transform data and load it into downstream systems, or ingest data from upstream systems and transform it for further processing.

You will be part of the SaaS Data Layer implementation team responsible for building and maintaining the client environments of the new trading platform.

Luxoft will invest into your professional training and allow you to grow your professional career.

Implement best practices for data governance, security, and compliance in cloud-based solutions.

Automate deployment and monitoring processes using CI/CD pipelines.

10+ years experience in development

Deep understanding of ETL/ELT workflows and big data processing frameworks.
Knowledge of Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
Familiarity with data security, governance, and compliance best practices in cloud environments.
Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in an agile development environment.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Range Operations
jobs.description:
Hej Software Engineer!

Do you want to furnish the future to make room for everyone?

With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our Digital Product Area: “Product Engineering”, a part of Digital Engineering at Inter IKEA, Range. The Product Engineering Area is dedicated to ensuring an attractive, consistent, and efficient way of working for product development and our suppliers. Our goal is to establish a strong foundation for IKEA's product information, enabling its seamless use across the entire value chain. We are growing our team in Malmö, Sweden, but you need to have great communication and collaboration skills to be able to integrate our offshore team.

Your new job

We’re looking for a software engineer who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on developing solutions for the handling of materials in our product designers' work, and you’ll report to a software engineering manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:
Build and evolve our material management solution, a core part of IKEA's digital landscape.
Develop web applications, APIs, and cloud services using Next.js, .NET, and Azure.
Contribute throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery and design to delivery and continuous improvement.
Be part of a team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and openness, while actively sharing knowledge and supporting others.
Bring curiosity and contribute ideas that improve both our products and ways of working.
Ensure high-quality software through code reviews, automated testing, and engineering best practices.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

This role as a Software Engineer requires you to:
Be highly skilled and experienced within React, NextJs and Typescript, a minimum of 3-5 years of work life experience
Be highly skilled and experienced within C# and .NET framework, a minimum of 3-5 years of work life experience
Have good knowledge of Azure.
Have good interpersonal skills: active listening, coaching and facilitation.
Be an excellent communicator by communicating in a clear, structured and honest way – both with inhouse and offshore team and colleagues
Have a deep understanding of IKEA's core values and cultural principles as well as a mindset and way of working that reflects this

It’s a plus if you also:
Worked with CI/CD, Terraform (IaC), Github Actions and cloud services
Have knowledge of database technologies like MongoDB, Postgres DB
Have experience with Jest/Playwright for Frontend testing
Are skilled in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces with React

Be yourself, a Software Engineer and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down-to-earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 13th of October at the latest.

This is a permanent role based in Malmö; hence, you need to be based in Sweden and be able to work from the office. We believe that your presence with the team and working most of the time in the workplace are important.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Vera Bendz, Recruiter, at vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com. If you have questions about the role, please contact Marie Önnemyr, Hiring Manager, at marie.onnemyr@inter.ikea.com.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, or what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs.
If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Rockets and Balloons
jobs.description:
Description

Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation). We work with space technology, launch services and systems used by customers around the world.

With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.

SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.

Do you want to work with software used in rocket and balloon operations? Are you comfortable with technical systems, troubleshooting and close cooperation with operations and IT?

We are looking for a Software Engineer for our Rockets and Balloons department at Esrange Space Center. The role is practical, technical and closely connected to our launch operations.

As Software Engineer, you will develop, maintain and improve software and operational systems used before, during and after rocket and balloon campaigns.

Requirements

We believe you have solid software development experience, work in a structured way and can cooperate with different technical functions.

Additional desired skills include Swedish language skills, experience with C, C++, .NET, C# or Rust, agile methods, test automation, project coordination, a university degree at bachelor level or higher, and leadership experience.

Fluency in English.
Software development and system administration skills.
Experience from Linux and Windows environments.
Deep experience in at least one programming language.
Ability to work in multidisciplinary technical environments.

### **Job summary**


We are currently looking for a **Senior Developer (SQ Web)** to join our **Technology and Service Operations** Function within the **Digital and Technology Group**.


This is a **full\-time** opportunity, on a **permanent** basis. The role will be based in 7/8 Wellington Place, Leeds, LS1 4AP.


Government departments and agencies are working towards implementing a minimum 60% attendance in office sites.

  

We are currently implementing a flexible, hybrid way of working, with a minimum of 8 days per month working on site to enable the collaboration and contact with partners and stakeholders needed to deliver MHRA business. Attendance on site is driven by business needs so depending on the nature of the role, this can flex up to 12 days a month, with the remainder of time worked either remotely or in the office. Some roles will need to be on site more regularly. Remote working is potentially available for some specific roles. Please discuss this with the recruiting manager before accepting an appointment.

  

### **Job description**

**Who are we?**


The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency enhance and improve the health of millions of people every day through the effective regulation of medicines and medical devices, underpinned by science and research.


The MHRA Digital and Technology Group (DTG) exists to help protect and improve public health by enabling the Agency to become a modern, intelligence\-led regulator.


We bring together digital, data, technology, cyber security and artificial intelligence expertise to deliver services, platforms and insights that support the regulation of medicines, medical devices and healthcare technologies across the UK.


Our work goes beyond traditional IT. We design and deliver user\-centred services, harness trusted data, apply advanced analytics and responsible AI, and build secure, resilient digital foundations that help the MHRA make better decisions, work more effectively and respond to a rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.


By joining DTG, you'll help shape the future of regulation while delivering technology that makes a real difference to public health.


The Technology \& Service Operations (TSO) function is responsible for managing the existing IT infrastructure including both software and hardware, databases, and other technology platforms; leading the support and maintenance of applications; development and testing of new applications and platforms; and cyber and information security for the Agency.


The Engineering team, made up of software developers, DevOps engineers, Quality Assurance testers, and data professionals (including engineers, scientists, and visualization experts), is tasked with the creation of applications and services, ensuring quality for both new and existing agency offerings, and developing data visualizations through their expertise in data engineering and science.

### **Person specification**

**Role Purpose**


This Senior Developer role implements web applications and guides the ways in which the team works and provide technical leadership, to deliver cloud native web\-based solutions to our end users. The post holder will be proficient in a wide range of technical systems and be involved in identifying appropriate technology and approaches, deciding when software should be written and will contribute to the developer community and promote knowledge sharing and adoption of good practice.


The post holder will work in cross\-functional product squads on the design and development of creating cloud native (Azure), JavaScript based microservices (node.js) and front end (react) utilising agile (SAFe), paired programming, TDD and DevOps.

 **Key responsibilities and results areas**

* As an experienced voice in the technical team, you will steer implementation and code design decisions for contingent labour and service providers
* Mentoring more junior members of your team to develop and maintain high\-performance, scalable solutions
* Assist in leading the design and development of site/software projects following best practices, as well as regular status reporting
* Assist in leading in optimising, debugging, and enhancing existing software whilst preventing regression in live systems
* You must have solid JavaScript coding skills, experience of TDD/BDD (jest, enzyme, cucumber, gherkin), be collaborative (Jira, Confluence, GitHub)
* You will establish good engineering practices and have strong ability with Open Source, Cloud First, Microservices and DevOps principles and its associated technology like React, Next.js, Node.js, Rust, Azure services (AKS, CosmosDB, Blob Storage, Functions), Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
* Contribute to a collaborative, dynamic planning process \- prioritising the work that needs to be done against the capacity and capability of the team ensuring the smooth and successful development of sites/software.

* Developing Self and Others

* Communicating and Influencing


We only ask for evidence of these behaviours on your application form:

* Making Effective Decisions
* Seeing the Big Picture

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:


* You will hold a Computer Science or similar engineering degree, ideally hold a post\-graduate qualification, or equivalent industry experience.
* You will ideally hold certifications with a major cloud provider (preferably in Azure) and as a microservice based full stack JavaScript developer.
* You will have previous experience as a developer working in a DDaT environment working on workstreams specific to the regulation of medicines/devices data and its subsequent caseworking.
* Substantial experience with certain tools and associated engineering processes.

Alongside your salary of £42,410, Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency contributes £12,286 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .* Annual Leave: 25 days annual leave on entry, rising by one day for each completed year of service to a maximum of 30 days and pro\-rata for part\-time staff. PLUS 8 bank holidays

* Occupational Sick Pay (OSP): One month full pay/one month half pay on entry, rising by one month for each completed year of service to a maximum of six months full pay and six months half pay after five years service.
* Mobility: Mobility clause in contracts allowing staff to be mobile across the Civil Service
* Civil Service Pension Scheme. Please see the link for further information http://www.civilservicepensionscheme.org.uk/ For enquiries relating to the Civil Service Pension Schemes please contact MyCSP's Pension Service Centre directly on 0300 123 6666
* Flexible working to ensure staff maintain a healthy work\-life balance
* Interest free season ticket loan or bike loan
* Employee Assistance Services and access to the Civil Service Benevolent Fund
* Eligibility to join Motoring , Boundless by CSMA
* Variety of staff and Civil Service clubs
* On\-going learning and development
**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**


Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.### **Selection process details**


This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Strengths, Experience and Technical skills.**Key dates** (dates are indicative only and could be subject to change)

* Closing date  11 October 2026 at 23:55
* Sifting  from 16 October 2026
* Main panel interviews  from 26 October 2026


Communications will be electronic via email therefore it is important that you check your Civil Service Jobs account regularly, as well as your spam/junk email folder.


Were committed to being diverse and inclusive, so please make your application anonymous by removing all identifying personal information (such as names and dates) from your employment history and personal statement.

**What will the process look like?**

**1\. Sift Stage**


The main sift, where we'll read and score the rest of your application. This may involve a large number of applications, please bear with us as this can take some time.

* **Anonymised CV** which sets out your career history, previous experience and skills, highlighting specific responsibilities that are relevant for this role.

Preferred Experience/Education/Skills:

* Experience with Power BI, Databricks, Azure, cloud technologies, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and analytics platforms.

jobs.title: Desarrollador/a de Software – ERP e Integraciones
jobs.description:
En **Recambios Frain** buscamos incorporar una persona al equipo de IT para ayudarnos a avanzar en nuevos desarrollos, mejorar aplicaciones que ya tenemos y participar en proyectos relacionados con ERP, logística, gestión interna y comercio B2B.

No buscamos necesariamente a alguien que domine todas las tecnologías que utilizamos. Buscamos una persona con experiencia en desarrollo, resolutiva y con capacidad para entender un negocio real y convertir necesidades en soluciones.

**¿En qué trabajarás?**

* Desarrollo y mejora de aplicaciones internas y aplicaciones web.
* Integraciones entre nuestros diferentes sistemas, ERP, SGA y otras herramientas.
* Automatización y mejora de procesos.
* Trabajo con bases de datos y optimización de consultas y procesos.
* Evolución y modernización de aplicaciones existentes.
* Uso de herramientas de IA como apoyo al desarrollo, análisis, documentación y automatización.

**¿Qué buscamos?**

Nos interesa especialmente experiencia en algunas de estas tecnologías o entornos:

* PHP y/o Python.
* SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
* Integraciones mediante APIs.
* ERP, SGA, Odoo o aplicaciones de gestión empresarial.
* .NET.
* Progress / OpenEdge.

No es necesario dominar todo lo anterior. Valoraremos especialmente que tengas una buena base técnica, autonomía, capacidad para aprender y experiencia trabajando sobre aplicaciones reales en producción.

**El puesto** 

La idea no es desarrollar software aislado del negocio. Trabajarás directamente sobre procesos que utilizan diariamente diferentes áreas de una empresa de más de 160 personas: logística, almacén, compras, ventas, administración, e\-commerce, etc.

Tenemos muchos proyectos pendientes y buscamos alguien que pueda incorporarse al equipo, aportar experiencia y asumir progresivamente proyectos propios.

Si estás interesado/a envíanos tu currículum para que podamos contactarte y entrar en más detalle sobre las condiciones de la vacante.
